positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on a physics-based digital twin simulation in Unity (C#) for robotic cell components, including 6-dof Fanuc arm, servo motors, and various end of arm tools. 
- Wrote Python scripts to compare real robot arm data (TP/Karel programs) to data generated from a proprietary simulation (C#).
- Created custom 6-dof arm simulator, incorporating inverse kinematics, frame transformations, and joint/cartesian trajectories.

positions.title: Graduate Researcher
positions.description:
•	Studied the benefits of rendering more expressive and personalized haptic cues.
•	Developed a wearable fingertip robotic device capable of displaying six-dimensional haptic cues, including normal and shear forces in all directions at any point on the fingertip.
•	Optimized the design of a 6-dof parallel continuum manipulator via MATLAB simulation.
•	Designed and constructed prototype using SOLIDWORKS, laser-cutting, and 3D printing.
•	Integrated MATLAB and C# code with Sensoray626 PCI board, trakSTAR electromagnetic tracker, Nano17 force transducer, and SynTouch BioTac sensor.
•	Programmed virtual environments in Unity for studies in which haptic interactions were rendered to a user in a Oculus VR headset.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Served as TA for classes on mechanical design and robotics.  As a TA I held weekly office hours, presented multiple lectures, and assisted in creating assignments/projects and preparing course materials.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
•	Research Intern (six months) at FRL working on haptics for AR/VR interaction.
•	Designed a pneumatic haptic wristband from thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) and integrated control of pneumatic valves and regulators into both C# and MATLAB projects.

company.name: Robotics and Autonomous Systems Lab (Vanderbilt University)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Project I: Intention-based assistive robot for impaired upper limbs
•	Constructed and evaluated a system designed to detect the intended motion of an impaired upper limb and provide 2-dof physical assistance as needed .
•	Designed and fabricated system using Pro/ENGINEER, laser-cutting, and 3D printing.
•	Developed controller that incorporated feedback from potentiometers, force-sensing resistors (FSRs), and a Tobii eye-tracker.
•	Implemented real-time communication between MATLAB, C#, Arduino, and XBee modules.
Project II: Autonomous robot-mediated imitation learning for children with autism
•	Implemented C# code allowing humanoid NAO robot to lead imitation therapy sessions for children with autism .
•	Developed rule-based gesture recognition with constructive feedback for failed gestures.
•	Improved inverse kinematics calculations for NAO’s 5-dof robotic arms to allow for more smooth and realistic mirroring of human gestures.

positions.description: •	Offered weekly tutorials to class of 20 undergraduate students

honors.title: University of Pennsylvania, MEAM Outstanding Teaching Assistant Award

volunteerExperiences.description: •	Prepared and presented weekly hands-on science lessons to local 5th-8th grade classes

-Supervised activities during week-long summer camp for children affected by a parent’s cancer.
-As a coordinator, helped increase number of Vanderbilt counselors from 9 to 17 and increase annual fundraising from $5,000 to $20,000.

-----This is a fantastic organization!  To all you college kids out there, find a way to get involved!

projects.title: Parallel Continuum Manipulator for 6-DOF Fingertip Haptic Display
projects.description:
- Optimized design of a 6-degree-of-freedom parallel continuum manipulator via MATLAB simulation 
- Designed and constructed prototype using SOLIDWORKS, laser cutters and 3D printers
- Integrated MATLAB and C++ code with Sensoray626 PCI board, Ascension trakSTAR electromagnetic tracker, ATI Nano17 force transducer, SynTouch BioTac sensor, and Access analog output USB module

projects.title: Low-Cost, Intention-Detecting Robot to Assist the Movement of an Impaired Upper Limb
projects.description:
-Developed system to determine a desired movement and provide as-needed assistance for individuals with impaired upper limbs.
-Incorporated closed-loop feedback using position data, force inputs, and eye-gaze data.
-Developed and implemented code in MATLAB, Arduino, and C# to control system allow system components to communicate via wireless data transmission, virtual socket communication, and wired serial communication.
-Designed and constructed entire system using purchased materials, laser cutter, and 3D printer.

publications.title: Compensating for Fingertip Size to Render Tactile Cues More Accurately
